title: An etale algebra is flat
statement: Let $A\to B$ be a homomorphism of commutative rings such that $\operatorname{Spec}B\to\operatorname{Spec}A$ is etale [def-weil-etale-morphism]. Then $B$ is a flat $A$-module [def-weil-pbc-flat-ring-map].
